description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Revived Conviction Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Revived Conviction Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1], [Damage Cap +10000 1] and Storm-Struck Memory +1 (max 2) to the user when the user's HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering
